Screen readers, keyboard-only users, and visually impaired visitors will struggle or fail to use key services. - **Business & Legal Risk:** High compliance and legal risk under WCAG 2.1 AA standards. Immediate outreach recommended to offer remediation. - **Primary Outreach Contact:** `intlsales@alkylamines.com` (`Verified`) ### Executive Overview & Pitch Angle This company currently scores **30/100** on automated WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility testing with **24 identified WCAG violations**. Addressing these compliance barriers will improve digital reach, satisfy regulatory requirements, and protect against accessibility lawsuits. --- ## 💻 Developer & Engineering Technical Breakdown - **Lighthouse A11y Metric:** `30/100` - **Axe-core Rule Engine Status:** Evaluated across Homepage DOM tree. - **Impact Breakdown:** Critical: `14` | Serious: `9` | Moderate: `1` ### Technical Violation Breakdown - 🖼️ **Missing Alt Text:** 13 violations - 🎨 **Color Contrast Failures:** 5 violations - 📝 **Form & Structural Labels:** 0 violations - ⌨️ **Keyboard Navigation & Focus:** 3 violations ### Priority Code Remediation Steps for Developers - **Image Alt Attributes (13 issues):** Add meaningful `alt="..."` text to all `` tags. Use `alt=""` for purely decorative images. - **Color Contrast Ratios (5 issues):** Ensure text contrast against background meets minimum 4.5:1 ratio for normal text and 3:1 for large text. - **Keyboard & Focus Management (3 issues):** Ensure all interactive buttons/links are focusable via `Tab` key and visual focus outlines are visible. --- ## 1. Company & Website Verification - **Company Name:** Alkyl Amines Chemicals Limited - **Resolved URL:** [https://alkylamines.com](https://alkylamines.com) - **Resolution Source:** `readymade-fallback` (HIGH Confidence) - **Status:** ✓ Verified & Confirmed - **Assigned Auditor:** Unassigned - **Verified By:** Orchavate Automated Tool v1.1 --- ## 2. Email & Contact Discovery - **Primary Contact Email:** `intlsales@alkylamines.com` (`Verified`) - **Overall Discovery Status:** `Verified` ### Discovered Accessibility / Compliance Endpoints - **General Contact Email:** `intlsales@alkylamines.com` | **Status:** `Verified` | **Source Page:** https://alkylamines.com --- ## 3. Detailed WCAG Violation Log (DOM Selectors) 1. **`[keyboard_navigation] aria-hidden-focus`** (SERIOUS) - **Help:** ARIA hidden element must not be focusable or contain focusable elements - **Selector:** `.slick-center.slick-current[data-slick-index="0"]` 2. **`[keyboard_navigation] aria-hidden-focus`** (SERIOUS) - **Help:** ARIA hidden element must not be focusable or contain focusable elements - **Selector:** `.slider > .slick-list.draggable > .slick-track > .slick-slide[data-slick-index="1"][aria-hidden="true"]` 3. **`[keyboard_navigation] aria-hidden-focus`** (SERIOUS) - **Help:** ARIA hidden element must not be focusable or contain focusable elements - **Selector:** `.slick-center.slick-slide[data-slick-index="2"]` 4. **`[other] aria-required-children`** (CRITICAL) - **Help:** Certain ARIA roles must contain particular children - **Selector:** `.custom_paging` 5. **`[color_contrast] color-contrast`** (SERIOUS) - **Help:** Elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds - **Selector:** `#slick-slide00 > .slide_inner > .banner-text > p > .blue-button > span` 6. **`[color_contrast] color-contrast`** (SERIOUS) - **Help:** Elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds - **Selector:** `.about-us-content > .blue-button > span` 7. **`[color_contrast] color-contrast`** (SERIOUS) - **Help:** Elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds - **Selector:** `.product-slide.slick-current[aria-hidden="false"] > .products-content > .container > .row > .col-lg-9 > .blue-button > span` 8. **`[color_contrast] color-contrast`** (SERIOUS) - **Help:** Elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds - **Selector:** `.div_content > .blue-button > span` 9. **`[color_contrast] color-contrast`** (SERIOUS) - **Help:** Elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds - **Selector:** `.fancybox.blue-button[href$="#writetous"] > span` 10. **`[missing_alt_text] image-alt`** (CRITICAL) - **Help:** Images must have alternative text - **Selector:** `#slick-slide00 > .slide_inner > .slide_img > .slide_img_tag` --- ## 4.
